SELECT DISTINCT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{teacher} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.effective_start_date <= #{date} AND (m.effective_end_date IS NULL OR m.effective_end_date >= #{date})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation_element_management_item_settings m WHERE m.management_item_code = #{code} AND m.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND m.active_yn = 'Y'

mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements a SET management_item_code = #{managementItemCode}, achievement_date = CAST(#{achievementDate} AS date), achievement_name = #{achievementName}, attachment_ref = #{attachmentRef}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE a.achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND a.achievement_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT' AND a.deleted_yn = 'N' AND a.achievement_status IN ('DRAFT', 'DEPARTMENT_REJECTED', 'CERTIFICATION_REJECTED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO education_achievement_status_histories ( achievement_type, achievement_id, previous_status, next_status, action_type, opinion, processed_by ) VALUES ( 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_ACHIEVEMENT', #{achievementId}, NULL, 'DRAFT', 'CREATE', '취업률 실적 최초 입력', #{updatedBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT j.batch_job_id AS "jobId", j.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear", j.action_type AS "actionType", j.target_condition_json::text AS "targetConditionJson", j.job_status AS "status", j.total_count AS "totalCount", j.success_count AS "successCount", j.failure_count AS "failureCount", j.excluded_count AS "excludedCount", j.success_count AS "processedCount", (j.total_count - j.success_count) AS "unprocessedCount", j.requested_by AS "requestedBy", j.requested_at AS "requestedAt" FROM employment_rate_batch_jobs j WHERE j.batch_job_id = #{id}

SELECT i.batch_job_item_id AS "jobItemId", i.target_user_id AS "targetUserId", i.processed_yn AS "processedYn", i.unprocessed_reason AS "unprocessedReason", i.processed_at AS "processedAt" FROM employment_rate_batch_job_items i WHERE i.batch_job_id = #{id} ORDER BY i.batch_job_item_id
